source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Send command: ipmitool sdr elist
Check sensor will change status when module is removed or inserted
Check SEL will have corresponding logs.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Temperature should have a normal change behavior.
2. All setting should be correct and match with spec.(including sdr type)
3. SEL should have a correct log when sensor reach to each threshold.
4. System should have correct behavior, like shutdown or change fan speed, when reach to threshold.
5. All STATUS_CRPS1~2 should get pass result.

historical_reviews.deepseek: NO; correctly makes CRPS service human-only.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: BLOCKED / CHANGED due status-versus-temperature mismatch and unspecified status semantics.

original_test_intent: Validate CRPS1 and CRPS2 removal/insertion status and SEL events, but the acceptance text instead requires temperature thresholds and thermal protection.
original_method: An engineer physically removes and reinstalls each CRPS while the BMC status and SEL are observed.
manual_activity: After correction, an engineer performs the CRPS removal/insertion; the agent only assists with telemetry and evidence.
required_inputs: Supported hot-service state and load envelope
safety_requirements: Do not remove a CRPS without confirmed redundancy and load margin.
Do not substitute AC cycling for CRPS status service.
Stop on power/thermal instability; no retry.
agent_execution_scope: After correction, capture both modules' status, power, SEL and host health around engineer actions.
Do not touch power hardware or decide verdict.
engineer_actions: Correct criteria and execute approved service action.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly identifies manual physical core; read-only IPMI remains supporting evidence.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use mapped status/power/SEL telemetry around each approved CRPS service action.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: CRPS1~2, physical service, script and 5/10 minutes remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Correct criteria, then remove/reinsert one CRPS at a time under load limits while logging presence, sharing, SEL and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor CRPS hot-service and redundancy SOP.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces copied thermal criteria with status/redundancy acceptance.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Preserves both CRPS slots and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Owner criteria decision and service envelope.

project_override_considerations: A project may prohibit live removal and use an approved powered-down service plan, but must state the changed coverage.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure tests physical CRPS presence/status, but Criteria 1-4 test temperature thresholds; code is additionally reused at row 1521 for an unrelated AC-drop case.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The core acceptance domain is contradictory, so manual execution alone cannot produce a valid result until corrected.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Manual boundary is correct but criteria conflict remains.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Rejects the duplicate AC-drop substitution and specifies recovery evidence.

review_improvement: Binds each CRPS service event to status, redundancy and restoration rather than temperature boilerplate.
independent_technical_reasoning: Presence events and thermal threshold events are different sensor classes; a removal may never exercise temperature thresholds, so the present criteria cannot judge the stated operation.
